title: Tyler as secret space program mission controller since Challenger

tellings.quote: collaborating with the secret space program person he's a mission controller who's worked on all these missions since the Challenger in the ' 80s is wild

plain: A man known only as Tyler is said to be a mission controller for a secret space program, a hidden counterpart to the public one, who has worked on its missions since the time of the Challenger shuttle in the 1980s. Michels says this himself, in a talk with the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, who he says works with Tyler, and calls the collaboration wild. If true, it would mean a secret space effort running for some forty years.
